name: Snared
source:
Snared is postmodern visual novel that parody's many of the tropes apparent in many modern visual novels.

Snared is set in the ancient year of... 2018.

The story is centralized around the narrative of the main character, Riya, having to deal with her newly acquired stalker and how she deals with him. Will you bash his brains in? Will you get him lit up like a Christmas tree by the police? Or will you just like... date him.

Bundle in years of trauma a coffee addiction and a manic best friend and you have an adventure that’ll be nothing but chaotic in the best possible way.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241005204713/https://nnull.itch.io/snared]itch.io[/url]]
